remarks: Discover the perfect location to build your dream home, located in the Town of Ellicottville and just 2 miles from the charming village of Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, and HoliMont ski resorts. This spacious lot offers a level entry point with a gentle slope that rises along a wooded ridge, creating the potential for beautiful hillside views with strategic building placement. A survey of the subdivision showing the approved building window is available. The lots are subject to town zoning law only, with no HOA or deed restrictions. Lot #1 offers views of the slopes and surrounding hills, which are gently sloping. Lots #6 and 7 (approx 6+ acres each) are more wooded, but command the same views of the surrounding hills. All the lots range in size from 6 -10+ acres, giving you even more options to expand your vision of your dream home. Bring your creativity and imagine your ideal getaway or year-round retreat. This is your chance to claim a piece of Ellicottville’s sought-after four-season lifestyle. Opportunity is knocking—don’t miss out! Taxes shown are for the entire acreage and will be determined once the subdivision of the lot sale is complete.
